name: inspira-file-tree
blurb: Hierarchical folder/file tree built with JSX children rather than data config.
description: Component-based tree view (Tree, Folder, File) where the structure is declared via JSX composition, not a data array. Tracks selected item and expanded folders via state. Folders render with toggle icons; files are selectable buttons. Supports RTL/LTR direction.
use_when: Custom, deeply-nested file structures where JSX composition is clearer than flat data arrays.
avoid_when: Large dynamic trees (1000+ items) where data arrays are more efficient to generate.
a11y: Folders and files are buttons with click handlers. No built-in roving tabindex or arrow-key navigation — focus must be managed externally.
